title: Canopus /dev/canopus transport v2 envelope (CAN-P0-008)
description: Decision record for the single versioned wire format on /dev/canopus. Legacy CPC1 (16-byte command) and CPS1 (384-byte status) remain only as the compatibility path; new operations are v2. The layout is fixed little-endian; a wire buffer is never dereferenced as a packed C struct.

total_size.description: must equal header_size + payload_size and fit the caller buffer

opcode.description: CANOPUS_CMD_*; a response echoes the request's opcode

request_id.description: client-monotonic; 0 is reserved for unsolicited events
